paths.reviewed_scope: Reviewed complete current native read/import flow and exact fix diff. Each bounded page reads raw_value and formula, validates the rectangle independently, and requires the same explicit nonnegative integer revision across both renderings and all pages. Merge keeps every raw field and adds only validated explicit formulas; it never derives formulas from literal values or overwrites raw scalar types with display strings. Malformed/cache/formula/revision disagreements fail before export emission and before the importer builds or executes writes. Dry-run includes both read requests. Read conflict recovery suggests a full reread without adding automatic mutation retry.
